wish: someone should make a standalone SVG editor
spec:
Draws rectangles, ovals, lines, freehand paths and text on an SVG canvas, and edits any attribute of any element.
Tap a tool, tap or drag on the canvas; select to move, resize, reorder, copy or delete; open a .svg file, edit it, save it back, or edit the raw source.
It does not do boolean path operations, node-by-node bezier editing, gradients by picker, or anything online.
notes: Opened files are cleaned of scripts and event attributes. External images in opened files will not load (no network by design).
